title: Rudolf Hess sent to Antarctica

tellings.quote: So, one of the main guys they send to Antarctica is Rudolph Hess.

plain: Hitler's deputy Rudolf Hess was "one of the main guys" the Nazis sent to Antarctica, says the writer Jason Jorjani, in connection with the Nazi expedition there in 1938 and 1939. Jorjani tells it without naming a source, crediting a work titled Hess and the Penguins. If true, it would tie the Nazi leadership itself to the Antarctic venture, which Jorjani links to his account of a Nazi UFO programme.
